22:     HAS_TORCH = True
23: except ImportError:
24:     HAS_TORCH = False
25: 
26: 
27: if not HAS_TORCH:
28: 
29:     class PyTorchBackend:
30:         def __init__(self):
31:             raise ValueError(
32:                 "Could not use the PyTorch backend since torch is not installed"
33:             )
34: 
35: else:
36: 
37:     class PyTorchBackend(object):
38:         """Class for the PyTorch  backend."""
39: 
40:         def __init__(self):
41:             self.backend_string = "pytorch"
42: 
43:             self.linalg = PyTorchLinalg()
44:             self.random = PyTorchRandom()
45:             self.testing = PyTorchTesting()
46: 
47:             self.int8 = _torch.int8
48:             self.int16 = _torch.int16
49:             self.int32 = _torch.int32
50:             self.int64 = _torch.int64
51:             self.float32 = _torch.float32
52:             self.float64 = _torch.float64
53:             self.complex64 = _torch.complex64
54:             self.complex128 = _torch.complex128
55: 
56:             self.abs = _torch.abs
57:             self.any = _torch.any
58:             self.arange = _torch.arange
59:             self.argmax = _torch.argmax
60:             self.argmin = _torch.argmin
61:             self.asarray = _torch.asarray
62:             self.dbl_max = _torch.finfo(_torch.double).max
63:             self.ceil = _torch.ceil
64:             self.diag = _torch.diag
65:             self.empty = _torch.empty
66:             self.exp = _torch.exp
67:             self.eye = _torch.eye
68:             self.floor = _torch.floor
69:             self.full = _torch.full
70:             self.hstack = _torch.hstack
71:             self.inf = _torch.inf
72:             self.is_array = _torch.is_tensor
73:             self.isfinite = _torch.isfinite
74:             self.isnan = _torch.isnan
75:             self.log = _torch.log
76:             self.max = _torch.max
77:             self.mean = _torch.mean
78:             self.median = _torch.median
79:             self.min = _torch.min
80:             self.nan = _torch.nan
81:             self.pairwise_euclidean_distances = _torch.cdist
82:             self.reshape = _torch.reshape
83:             self.round = _torch.round
84:             self.sum = _torch.sum
85:             self.vstack = _torch.vstack
86:             self.zeros = _torch.zeros
87:             self.zeros_like = _torch.zeros_like
88: 
89:         @staticmethod
90:         def all(x, axis=None):
91:             if not _torch.is_tensor(x):
92:                 x = _torch.tensor(x)
93:             if axis is None:
94:                 return x.bool().all()
95:             if isinstance(axis, int):
96:                 return _torch.all(x.bool(), axis)
97:             if len(axis) == 1:
98:                 return _torch.all(x, *axis)
99:             axis = list(axis)
100:             for i_axis, one_axis in enumerate(axis):
101:                 if one_axis < 0:
102:                     axis[i_axis] = x.ndim() + one_axis
103:             new_axis = tuple(k - 1 if k >= 0 else k for k in axis[1:])
104:             return all(_torch.all(x.bool(), axis[0]), new_axis)
105: 
106:         def array(self, val, dtype=None):
107:             if _torch.is_tensor(val):
108:                 if dtype is None or val.dtype == dtype:
109:                     return val.clone()
110:                 return self.cast(val, dtype=dtype)
111: 
112:             elif isinstance(val, _np.ndarray):
113:                 tensor = self.from_numpy(val)
114:                 if dtype is not None and tensor.dtype != dtype:
115:                     tensor = self.cast(tensor, dtype=dtype)
116: 
117:                 return tensor
118: 
119:             elif isinstance(val, (list, tuple)) and len(val):
120:                 tensors = [self.array(tensor, dtype=dtype) for tensor in val]
121:                 return _torch.stack(tensors)
122: 
123:             return _torch.tensor(val, dtype=dtype)
124: 
125:         @staticmethod
126:         def belongs_to_backend(x):
127:             return "torch" in str(type(x)).lower()
128: 
129:         def cast(self, x, dtype):
130:             if _torch.is_tensor(x):
131:                 return x.to(dtype=dtype)
132:             return self.array(x, dtype=dtype)
133: 
134:         @staticmethod
135:         def cdist(x, y, metric="euclidean", p=None):
136:             if metric == "euclidean":
137:                 return _torch.cdist(x, y)
138:             if metric == "sqeuclidean":
139:                 return _torch.cdist(x, y) ** 2
140:             if metric == "minkowski":
141:                 return _torch.cdist(x, y, p=p)
142:             raise ValueError(f"Metric {metric} not implemented in PyTorch backend.")
143: 
144:         @staticmethod
145:         def copy(x):
146:             return x.clone()
147: 
148:         @staticmethod
149:         def from_numpy(x):
150:             return _torch.from_numpy(x)
151: 
152:         @staticmethod
153:         def iscomplex(x):
154:             if isinstance(x, complex):
155:                 return True
156:             return x.dtype.is_complex
157: 
158:         @staticmethod
159:         def is_float(x):
160:             if isinstance(x, float):
161:                 return True
162:             return x.dtype.is_floating_point
163: 
164:         @staticmethod
165:         def is_float32(x):
166:             return isinstance(x, _torch.float32)
167: 
168:         @staticmethod
169:         def is_float64(x):
170:             return isinstance(x, _torch.float64)
171: 
172:         @staticmethod
173:         def ndim(x):
174:             return x.dim()
175: 
176:         @staticmethod
177:         def pairwise_distances(X, Y=None, metric="euclidean"):
